needs.reason: the three Gradle builds compute their model while running: fraud-detection adds javax.annotation-api only when JavaVersion.current() is 9 or later, ad replaces every dependency with a fileTree of jars under -Pspeed, ad and recommendation read -PprotoSourceDir and recommendation takes its versions from the Spring Boot BOM of the plugin; cart.csproj picks ProtosDir with an MSBuild Exists() condition and both .NET projects import Directory.Build.props and Directory.Packages.props; the currency CMake targets need demo.proto copied in by the Dockerfile, protoc output generated at build time and opentelemetry-cpp built from source

traps: pb/demo.proto is the one contract of eleven units, and each gets it in its own way: the Accounting Dockerfile copies it to src/protos/demo.proto, the currency Dockerfile to proto/demo.proto, the fraud-detection Dockerfile to src/main/proto/, the payment Dockerfile next to index.js (loadSync('demo.proto') at run time), ad and recommendation receive -PprotoSourceDir=./proto, cart.csproj falls back to ../../../pb when ../pb is missing, Go and TypeScript units check the generated code in. In a plain checkout src/accounting/src/protos/demo.proto, src/currency/proto/demo.proto and src/payment/demo.proto do not exist

oteldemo.ShippingService and oteldemo.EmailService are declared in demo.proto and checkout builds a client for each, but no call goes through them: shipping (Rust, actix-web) and email (Ruby, Sinatra) speak HTTP JSON, and checkout posts to /get-quote, /ship-order and /send_order_confirmation; ide-gen-proto.sh still runs gen_proto_rust for shipping although the crate has no build.rs and no proto

oteldemo.FeatureFlagService has no implementer: flags come from the external flagd image, which reads src/flagd/demo.flagd.json; flagd-ui edits the same file through a shared volume (./src/flagd mounted at /app/data)
recommendation is a Java Spring Boot gRPC service built with Gradle, not Python

the product-catalog module path is github.com/opentelemetry/opentelemetry-demo/src/product-catalog (no hyphen), unlike checkout's github.com/open-telemetry/...; internal/tools declares github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/internal/tools with go 1.12, copied from another repository
the composer package is named openteletry-demo/quote (sic): the name is taken as written; php >= 8.5, ext-json and ext-pcntl in require are platform requirements, not packages

ad, fraud-detection and recommendation are three separate single-project Gradle builds, each with the project path ':' (rootProject.name opentelemetry-demo-ad, fraud-detection, opentelemetry-demo-recommendation); no settings file joins them, so connections name them by their root
ad's build.gradle adds srcDirs 'oteldemo' (src/ad/oteldemo does not exist) and the oteldemo subfolders of the generated proto output, which the protobuf plugin already adds as a whole

Java versions disagree: ad asks 21 in .java-version (21.0) and sourceCompatibility, recommendation release 21, both build and run on Temurin 24 images; fraud-detection targets JVM 17 and builds with the gradle:9.8.2-jdk17 image by running gradle, not ./gradlew, so its wrapper's 9.9.0 is not used in the image
Node versions disagree: frontend and payment build on node 26.12.1 and run on distroless nodejs24; the React Native CI job uses node 24; no package.json has engines or packageManager
Go versions disagree: go.mod asks go 1.26.0, the service Dockerfiles use golang 1.27.3, opamp-server 1.27.1 and CI 1.27.1; no toolchain line anywhere
Python versions disagree: 3.14-slim for agent, chatbot and mcp, 3.15.0 for load-generator and telemetry-docs, 3.12-alpine for test/telemetry, 3.x in CI, while every pip-compile header says 3.14
requirements.in is the declaration and requirements.txt the hashed pip-compile lock, transitive packages included (184 pinned names for agent against 25 declared)

agent, chatbot and mcp import their code as the package src (src.agents, src.chat_interface, src.mcp_server) from run.py, with no __init__.py; agent and mcp also import tools.py that their Dockerfiles copy from src/shared, a dependency stated only by the Dockerfiles, so depends_on names the source-tree src/shared by its root

src/currency/build/ is checked-in protoc and grpc_cpp_plugin output (header: NO CHECKED-IN PROTOBUF GENCODE) that the Dockerfile copies in and regenerates; the include dir ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/proto equals that folder only when CMake runs in src/currency/build as the Dockerfile does
opentelemetry-cpp 1.28.0 and the Java agent 2.31.1 are versions in .env passed as build args: one is cloned and built from source, the other downloaded as a jar; neither is a toolchain

the Go genproto files carry 'Code generated ... DO NOT EDIT.' on line 15 after a licence header; flags/flags_gen.go is generated by the OpenFeature CLI from flags.json; the go.mod tool blocks (protoc-gen-go, protoc-gen-go-grpc) are tool dependencies for go generate

frontend-proxy (Envoy), image-provider (nginx), kafka, opensearch, flagd, otel-collector, jaeger, grafana, prometheus and opamp-server are Compose services without project code: some Dockerfiles only add configuration or the Java agent, opamp-server is built from github.com/open-telemetry/opamp-go at OPAMP_GO_REF; none is a unit
.env names POSTGRES_DOCKERFILE=./src/postgresql/Dockerfile, which does not exist: astronomy-db runs the postgres:18.6 image with src/postgresql/init.sql mounted

Compose is split by profile: compose.yaml is the minimal set; Kafka, accounting and fraud-detection exist only in compose.full.yaml, agent, mcp and chatbot only in compose.agent.yaml, the observability backends only in compose.observability.yaml; image versions are .env variables, not literals in the Compose files
there are no Kubernetes or Helm files at this commit

react-native-app is an Expo app: android/ and ios/ are generated by expo prebuild in android.Dockerfile and in CI, not checked in; its Gemfile (CocoaPods) is a second unit in the same folder and takes Ruby from .ruby-version through ruby file:; tsconfig extends expo/tsconfig.base from node_modules; main is expo-router/entry, a package, not a file
frontend's next.config.js loads ../../.env (the repository root) at build time; tsconfig includes next-env.d.ts, which Next.js generates
email declares google-protobuf but never requires it, and Pony sends mail with via: :test: no SMTP service is needed
cart keeps carts in Valkey through StackExchange.Redis: the name Redis appears only in package names
the agent's LLM is ChatOpenAI against LLM_BASE_URL (https://local-llm.com by default), replayed from VCR cassettes when USE_VCR=True; the cassettes are recordings, not code

cart.tests is an xunit test project, so its packages are test scope; their versions are in src/cart/Directory.Packages.props (central package management) and there is no packages.lock.json, so resolved is null

internal/tools pins misspell and addlicense through tools.go under the tools build tag (dev scope); the Python scripts beside it (sanitycheck.py, check_collector_pipelines.py, which imports yaml) have no manifest of their own
an unnamed Docker stage is cited by its index (Dockerfile#stage 2), as COPY --from would number it
src/frontend/Dockerfile.cypress and src/react-native-app/android.Dockerfile are Dockerfiles by content; the .h files in src/currency/src are C++
